title: RCA Asset Record
description: Canonical schema for a single discovered network asset. Used by Scout (write) and Mapper (read) to ensure a stable data contract across agents.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the discovered asset.

mac_address.description: MAC address in colon-separated or dash-separated format. 'Unknown' is acceptable for L3-only discoveries.

discovery_method.description: Which RCA discovery technique found this asset.

open_ports.description: List of open ports discovered by the PortScanner.

is_high_risk.description: True if this port is flagged as high-risk by the PortScanner.

ot_protocol.description: Industrial protocol detected by the IndustrialScanner.

ot_device_info.description: Device identification string returned by the industrial protocol probe.

nist_status.description: Optional per-control compliance status for this asset. Keys are control IDs (e.g. '3.4.1'), values are status strings.

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of first discovery.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of most recent confirmation.
